checks: all input rows and ordinals are preserved, including registry-only zero-count vessels
valid coordinate, 25-position/3-date history, and known one-degree haversine distance pass
exact nearest-distance ties choose earliest timestamp, then lowest ordinal at that timestamp
a repeated past centroid yields zero distance; same-time/current and future rows are excluded
t-720 is included while t-721 is excluded; resulting 24/23 position gate is exact
24 past positions on only two distinct source-clock dates defer
NaN and out-of-range current coordinates are retained and explicitly deferred
peer count excludes own vessel and accepts five history-qualified peers without current observations
known singleton and unknown gear keep own distance eligibility but defer at the peer stage
availability stages are monotone: valid current coordinate, own history, then peer history
appending a future row leaves existing reference counts, distances, peers, and eligibility unchanged
duplicate RFID/hour/ordinal and fractional source-clock keys are rejected

definitions.history_window: valid finite/range-checked centroid rows in [t-720,t); current/future excluded
definitions.history_gate: at least 24 valid positions and 3 distinct floor(ts/24) source-clock dates
definitions.distance: minimum haversine distance to past centroid rows, Earth radius 6371000 m; proxy only
definitions.peer_gate: own distance eligible and at least 5 other history-eligible vessels in same known single-code gear at query t

ram_preflight.basis: bounded 720-hour histories and per-row distance vector; fixed Luna 768 + Gemini 512 + 640 reserve, plus 512 per other visible Python job

scope: synthetic in-memory coordinates only; no actual source, labels, events, scoring, or training accessed
